description: General-purpose work unit card — tasks, bugs, chores, spikes, and features with slotted title, status, priority, assignee, and linked stories

attributes.name: item-id
attributes.description: Unique work item identifier; sets the HTML id on first connect when none is set

attributes.name: detail
attributes.description: Detail level. minimal shows id, type and title only.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a JSON work-item record. Fetched once per value; a newer value aborts the older request.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Work item heading (e.g., <h3>). There is no title attribute.

events.name: work-item:ready
events.description: Once per element, after the first render at any detail level. With src, after the fetched data renders (not fired if the fetch fails). Not re-fired by attribute changes or moves.

events.name: work-item:status
events.description: When updateStatus() is called with a known status

events.name: work-item:priority
events.description: When updatePriority() is called with a known priority

events.name: work-item:upgraded
events.description: Once, in a microtask after first connect. Wait for this before assigning .data from a framework.
